dimensions.name: Customer Definition
dimensions.pass_criteria: A specific named persona, role, segment, or job title is identified.
dimensions.fail_criteria: Customer is vague, such as users, teams, enterprises, people, or customers without further specificity.

dimensions.name: Problem Evidence
dimensions.pass_criteria: The problem is specific and evidenced with a concrete pain, current workaround, frequency, cost, or quote.
dimensions.fail_criteria: The problem is generic and lacks evidence that this is a real, acute pain.

dimensions.name: Customer Benefit
dimensions.pass_criteria: The customer can tell exactly what changes for them, and the headline and solution paragraph agree.
dimensions.fail_criteria: The benefit is vague or disconnected from the stated problem.

dimensions.name: Spokesperson Quote
dimensions.pass_criteria: The quote explains the insight, mission, or opportunity in language a real person could say.
dimensions.fail_criteria: The quote is generic launch or marketing language.

dimensions.name: Customer Quote
dimensions.pass_criteria: The quote is specific and believable, with placeholders clearly marked when not yet validated.
dimensions.fail_criteria: The quote invents unsupported metrics or uses generic praise.

dimensions.name: Question Quality
dimensions.pass_criteria: Every question represents a genuine challenge a skeptical customer would raise.
dimensions.fail_criteria: Questions are softballs or leading questions that assume a positive answer.

dimensions.name: Answer Completeness
dimensions.pass_criteria: Every question has a substantive answer or is explicitly marked open with a named owner.
dimensions.fail_criteria: Questions are unanswered, marked TBD, or open without an owner.

dimensions.name: No Evasive Answers
dimensions.pass_criteria: Each answer directly resolves the question or names uncertainty.
dimensions.fail_criteria: Answers deflect, restate the question, or use vague future promises.

dimensions.name: Coverage of Critical Concerns
dimensions.pass_criteria: The FAQ covers data/privacy, workflow change, cost/value, failure modes, and alternatives.
dimensions.fail_criteria: A critical adoption concern is missing.

dimensions.name: Stakeholder Coverage
dimensions.pass_criteria: The FAQ includes hard questions from engineering, business/leadership, and legal/compliance where applicable.
dimensions.fail_criteria: One or more stakeholder perspectives are absent or only represented by softball questions.

dimensions.name: Answer Completeness
dimensions.pass_criteria: Every question has a substantive answer or is explicitly marked open with a named owner.
dimensions.fail_criteria: Questions are unanswered, marked TBD, or open without an owner.

dimensions.name: Blocker Identification
dimensions.pass_criteria: Any open item that would prevent safe build handoff is flagged as a blocker.
dimensions.fail_criteria: Build-blocking issues are buried as normal open items or omitted.

dimensions.name: No Evasive Answers
dimensions.pass_criteria: Hard questions receive direct answers, explicit open items, or explicit blockers.
dimensions.fail_criteria: Hard questions receive vague, aspirational, or deflecting answers.

dimensions.name: Requirement Traceability
dimensions.pass_criteria: Every requirement traces to the press release, external FAQ, internal FAQ, or named open item.
dimensions.fail_criteria: Requirements appear without source artifact IDs or source rationale.

dimensions.name: Testable Acceptance Criteria
dimensions.pass_criteria: Acceptance criteria use observable given/when/then behavior.
dimensions.fail_criteria: Acceptance criteria are vague, subjective, or cannot be tested.

dimensions.name: Edge Case Coverage
dimensions.pass_criteria: Key failure modes, boundary cases, and recovery paths are named.
dimensions.fail_criteria: Only the happy path is described.

dimensions.name: Non-Functional Requirements
dimensions.pass_criteria: Performance, security/privacy, reliability, observability, accessibility, and scale/cost are covered or explicitly open.
dimensions.fail_criteria: Non-functional requirements are missing without open items.

dimensions.name: Open Item Propagation
dimensions.pass_criteria: Open items and blockers from prior stages are preserved with owner and impact.
dimensions.fail_criteria: Open items disappear, are softened, or are worked around silently.
